game_title: Off By One Fixer – Misty Bog Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Mystic Forest – Misty Bog, a misty bog: the forest ranger must handle bog toads while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Off By One Fixer: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one.
theme: Mystic Forest – Misty Bog: a misty bog
core_gameplay_loop: In Misty Bog, repeat each round: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one. Each round, bog toads strike the seed vault, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the fixes value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the seed vault from bog toads in Misty Bog: keep the fixes meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 51-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: fixes drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 51-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Off By One Fixer
